groups.description: Rebuilds Session 1 session metrics one event at a time
groups.idempotency: deterministic snapshot keyed by website_session_id; replay upserts the same final state

groups.description: Independent idempotent audit view of purchase conversions
groups.idempotency: conversion audit sink has event_id PRIMARY KEY; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING rejects redelivery

groups.description: Idempotent refund projection and refunded value
groups.idempotency: refund sink keyed by event_id; replay updates the same event row

second_run_behavior: Consumers can replay the retained history; idempotent sinks preserve the same logical final state.
brand_new_group_behavior: Starts at offset 0 and can read all retained history.
